name: Tatneft (PJSC)
via: AO Svyazinvestneftekhim (sole shareholder: the Republic of Tatarstan) holds 27.23% of charter capital (29.07% of voting shares); the Republic of Tatarstan also holds a 'golden share' over the company under its Articles of Association
note: Listed on the Moscow Exchange. General sponsor of HC Ak Bars Kazan; the wordmark is on the front of the 2026/27 home jersey. The club is operated by LLC SKP "Tatneft - Ak Bars", owned by Tatneft (Stavka TV, 2026).
